description: Reviewed corrections to cells of the POS disambiguation tables (treebank_pos_lookup.json, glaux_pos_lookup.json, ag_pos_lookup.json). Dilemma applies them when it loads the tables, so they take effect without a table rebuild. A row applies only while the table still holds its 'target' for that form and tag; a rebuilt table that already fixed the cell leaves the row a no-op. action 'drop' removes the cell, so a lower-priority table can supply the tag; 'correct' replaces the target with 'corrected'.
